_comment: Copy to jarvis.jobs.profile.json (git-ignored) and fill in ONLY what you are happy for JARVIS to submit on application forms. Anything left blank is never guessed: a required question it cannot answer from this file stops the application and asks you. Check with: npm run jobs -- audit

demographics._comment: policy 'skip' leaves optional demographic questions blank; 'decline' picks a 'Prefer not to say' option where the form offers one. A per-question answer below always wins. Required demographic questions with no answer and no decline option need your input.

declarations._comment: Set true only if you want JARVIS to tick these boxes for you.
